text: Polarstepsは、旅行中に移動した経路を自動で地図に記録できるアプリだ。
quote:
Travel tracker
Capture your route automatically
Easily add photos, videos and stories
Let your friends and family follow along
See your trips and stats unfold on the map

text: 旅行者は旅のリンクを共有すると、家族や友人に現在の様子をまとめて伝えられる。
quote: Just completed a 4 month trip using Polarsteps. Totally love it, easy to use, helps me remember the journey and stops me wasting time private messaging people about what we are doing, I just share the link, a real time and memory saver.

text: 旅行者はPolarstepsの旅の記録を、硬い表紙の紙の本にできる。
quote: Transform your trip into a beautiful hardback book

text: NiekにJob、Koen、Maximilianoが加わり、Polarstepsの創業チームができた。
quote: Those believers were Job, Koen, and Maximiliano . Together, they joined Niek to form an adventure-seeking founding team of four.

text: PolarstepsはiPhone用の試用版アプリを公開した。
quote: The beta version of Polarsteps’ iPhone app was launched in April 2015 and has rapidly gained traction amongst travelers.

text: Polarstepsは、旅の記録を紙の本にする商品Travel Bookを発売した。
quote: Polarsteps, the popular travel tracking app, today announces the launch of its "Travel Book": an instant photo album designed for the avid traveler.

text: Travel Bookは旅の記録から本の配置を自動で作り、利用者が写真集の編集に時間をかける手間を減らした。
quote: The layout of a Travel Book is generated by Polarsteps based on all details of a trip, taking away the hassle of having to spend evenings in a photo album editor.

text: Travel Bookの発売時の料金は、硬い表紙の本で20ユーロからだった。
quote: Pricing starts at €20 ($22) for a 24-page hardcover album, and includes worldwide shipping and taxes.

text: Polarstepsは利用者の要望を受けて本の販売機能を作り、この機能が事業の収入を支えるようになった。
quote: “Even though this was just a feature we implemented because users were asking for it, it quickly became a fundamental income stream for us,” Neustadt tells us.

text: Polarstepsは、アプリ内の旅行案内を見た利用者が宿泊先などを予約すると、予約に応じた収入を受け取る。
quote: Polarsteps has recently added destination guides as a way for people to find best places to eat, sleep, and drink around the world. When people book something they have seen on a destination guide, Polarsteps gets a revenue share.

text: 旅行がほぼ止まった時期にも、利用者はPolarstepsで過去の旅を振り返り、写真をTravel Booksにした。
quote: As travel lovers adapted to the new reality of being stuck in one place, they started reliving the memories of past trips on Polarsteps, and using their time to convert their photos into Travel Books .

text: Polarstepsは利用者が他の旅行者にアプリを勧めることで広がった。
quote: This led to so much user love that travelers recommended the app to other travelers themselves. We grew organically.

text: Polarstepsは利用者の要望を受け、仲間と旅の記録を共同で作る機能を開発した。
quote: The team built features like Travel Together (the ability to plan and track your trip as a couple or group) and Trip Reels (an auto-generated video of your trip) in response to requests from people all over the world who were using Polarsteps to track their adventures.

text: Polarstepsの利用者数は100万人を超えた。
quote: Amsterdam-based travel startup Polarsteps today announced that it has broken through the 1 million user mark and raised €3 million (USD $3.5 million) in funding.

text: Polarstepsは投資会社と報道会社から50万ユーロを調達したと発表した。
quote: Polarsteps, an upcoming automatic travel tracking app, announced today that it has raised €500,000 in seed funding from Silver Point Ventures and TMG.

text: Polarstepsが公表した調達額の累計は460万ユーロになった。
quote: The Series A round, which was led by INKEF Capital, brings Polarsteps’ total funding to date to €4.6 million (USD 5.25 million).

text: Polarstepsは旅行記の本を利用者に販売して収入を得ていた。
quote: Polarsteps makes money by letting users buy Travel Books : instant photo albums of trips that can be ordered at the push of a button.

text: Polarstepsの世界の利用者数は1,500万人になった。
quote: With 15 million users worldwide and explosive growth, Polarsteps has become a standout success story, attracting media attention across Europe.

text: Polarstepsの公式サイトは、世界の利用者数が2,200万人を超えていると案内している。
quote: Join the 22M+ travelers who plan, track, and relive their trips with Polarsteps.

text: Polarstepsは追加機能を使える有料プランの提供を発表した。
quote: Polarsteps today announced the launch of Polarsteps Plus, a new optional subscription that brings advanced features to travelers who want to dive deeper into their adventures.

text: 有料の追加機能は、長距離の登山などで地形や移動の詳しい記録を求める利用者のために作られた。
quote: Having a subscription allows us to bring more of the features that certain users are craving: the hikers doing epic multi-week trips, for example, or the skiers tackling backcountry terrain.

text: 立体の地図や移動の詳しい記録を使える有料機能の料金は、月払いで8.99ユーロだ。
quote: Polarsteps Plus monthly costs €8.99* per month and includes all Polarsteps Plus features, such as 3D maps, step stats, 3D play, new map styles, and more Travel Buddies, but no Travel Books discount.

text: Wildgrainは、パンや菓子、生パスタを家庭に届ける定期購入サービスだ。
quote: Wildgrain bread delivery membership boxes come with real sourdough bread, artisanal pastries and fresh pasta.

text: 利用者は、届いたパンや菓子を解凍せずに焼き、好きなときに焼きたてを食べられる。
quote: Our products bake-from-frozen in 25 minutes or less - no thawing required! We do the hard work, so you don't have to.

text: Johanna Hartzheimは、パリの学校で製品のデザインを学んだ。
quote: After graduating from a prestigious Industrial Design school in Paris, Johanna joined forces with Ismail on a music industry project, leading to the creation of their first company, backed by Bose.

text: Johanna HartzheimとIsmail Salhiは、Wildgrainを始める前に音楽業界のプロジェクトで協力し、最初の会社を立ち上げていた。
quote: After graduating from a prestigious Industrial Design school in Paris, Johanna joined forces with Ismail on a music industry project, leading to the creation of their first company, backed by Bose.

text: Johanna Hartzheimは、第一子の妊娠をきっかけにWildgrainを始めた。
quote: I started Wildgrain 9 months ago when I got pregnant with my first son Jack.

text: Johanna Hartzheimは、市販品に満足できず、自宅で作る食品のレシピを研究した。
quote: So, I decided to study and develop my own homemade recipes with organic ingredients, healthy fibers, and a more artisanal process.

text: Johanna Hartzheimと夫がWildgrainを共同で始めた。
quote: A week before Jack’s birthday, on January 2020, my husband and I co-founded Wildgrain.

text: Johanna Hartzheimは、ドイツの友人宅で食べたパンをきっかけに、パン作りに打ち込んだ。
quote: A trip to Germany reignited that passion when Johanna tasted sourdough at a friend’s house and thought, “this is the best bread I’ve ever had.” That led to an obsession with baking,

text: 創業当初のパンや菓子は、Johanna Hartzheimが手作業で作っていた。
quote: sparked the creation of Wildgrain, where she initially crafted all the breads and pastries by hand.

text: Wildgrainは黒字になった。
quote: “We have been profitable since 2023 with a pretty healthy EBIDTA and are cash-flow positive and debt-free,” Salhi said.

text: Wildgrainの既存客には、夏の間だけ定期配送を休む人がいた。
quote: After digging in further, the company found that existing Wildgrain subscribers tend to pause during the summer.

text: Wildgrainは、年明けに広告予算を増やす方針を取った。
quote: Wildgrain usually begins testing various changes to its marketing channel mix at the beginning of October and ramps up its budget in January, which is when its ad spending typically peaks.

text: Wildgrainは、音声番組の広告とインターネット経由で見るテレビの広告を試した。
quote: This channel mix now includes podcast advertising and connected TV, which Wildgrain began testing for the first time in 2023.

quote:
Wildgrain Box

Every 1 month

text: Wildgrainの会員は15万人を超える。
quote: Over 150,000 Wildgrain members bake with us every day.

text: Wildgrainは、創業したソマービルに実店舗Wildgrain Bakehouseを開いた。
quote: Wildgrain started in a Somerville kitchen, so it’s only right our first Bakehouse opens here.
